protocol.memory_window: Whole App launch through 3seconds after READY errors0 and180x180decode; no screenshot/PERF inside. MEMORYSTART local minimum, separately record stable heap. Fixed2seconds log drain after registry inactive, not full teardown proof.
protocol.gate: All4 candidate attempts must complete. Equal4 attempted starts per variant; compare phase-matched stable and localwindowpeak maxima using ONLY completed same QR paths, independently SRAM andPSRAM. Candidate maxima must not exceed completed-old maxima; at least one completed old per phase required. Failed-old attempts retained and never used for memory/time benefit. No append to seek pass.
protocol.gate_change_vs_p60: A baseline timeout is an existing defect, not automatically a candidate defect. Unlike P60 all10 prerequisite, allow improvement if candidate is complete and all its per-heap maxima do not exceed completed baseline paths; fewer complete baselines make this max comparison conservative and counts explicit. No allowance for memory growth.

protocol.account: No user QRscan, no credential reuse/import. Original HTML+4scripts; publicQRAPI images can vary; retain encoded sizes.
